text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim and closing restatement","quality":"thesis and conclusion","description":"It states a position up front and returns to it at the end, giving the piece a more complete argumentative shape."},{"evidence":"three distinct body paragraphs with separate reasons","quality":"organized reasoning","description":"It divides its argument into clear points, which makes the case easier to follow than B's mostly continuous paragraphing."},{"evidence":"uses examples like lawsuits and Americans being lazy to support claims","quality":"developed support","description":"It offers more elaboration for each reason instead of relying mainly on questions and general concerns."},{"evidence":"references article details such as sensors and seat vibrations","quality":"source use","description":"It brings in specific information from the text to address the opposing side, which strengthens its connection to the prompt."},{"evidence":"mostly complete sentences with readable punctuation","quality":"sentence control","description":"Its writing is more consistently controlled and understandable, while B is much more fragmented and run-on."}]}
